title: Studio
subtitle: 本課集中處理 studio = professional design / creative business 的義項。 不處理錄音室、攝影棚、藝術家個人工作空間或 studio
description: 本課集中處理 studio = professional design / creative business 的義項。 不處理錄音室、攝影棚、藝術家個人工作空間或 studio flat。這個商業義項最重要的差異是：純設計公司、較廣創意代理、專業 design practice、策略顧問、品牌專門公司、獨立小型公司。

options.explanation: Design firm ✓ — means a professional business providing design services. Here, professional design services to clients. The service model and professional register make Design firm the most precise replacement.

Creative studio — means a small or specialist creative business producing visual, digital or artistic work. This keeps the creative-business idea but misses the more specific firm, consultancy, branding or independence nuance. The decisive clue is that professional design services to clients.

Design practice — is a British/professional term for a design business, especially in architecture/interiors. This is most natural in professional architecture/interiors and formal design-practice contexts. The decisive clue is that professional design services to clients.

Office — means a workplace and says nothing about the professional service provided. This only identifies a workplace, not the organisation's professional service. The decisive clue is that professional design services to clients.

Freelancer — means an individual self-employed professional, not a studio/company. This refers to one self-employed person rather than a studio team or company. The decisive clue is that professional design services to clients.

Production house — means a company focused on media/content production. This is production-focused, especially film/video/content, and does not match general design services. The decisive clue is that professional design services to clients.
